summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a trivial one-line test library but its `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling ~727 KB `math_init.js` file. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated using an obfuscator.io-style string array with rotator function (`WV8StW(a,n,i){for(i=0;i<n;i++)a.push(a.shift());return a}`) and hex-mangled identifiers, hiding what actually executes at install time. The package's stated purpose (`test pob`, one-line library) provides no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate runtime or execute a large opaque blob. Running the payload under a freshly downloaded Bun binary rather than the ambient Node.js interpreter also bypasses Node-scoped install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
